people.name: Dev
observations: Jordan bailed on Dev Monday with a fake excuse about being swamped
Jordan texted Dev the real reason: bad news at work and shutting down
Dev replied within about a minute thanking Jordan for telling the truth
Dev said they would rather know Jordan is having a bad week than think Jordan didn't want to see them
Dev said they also disappear sometimes, but with a bass in their hands so it looks productive
Jordan and Dev are getting lunch Saturday

people.name: Mika
observations: Mika got around Jordan's habit of hiding struggles years ago by refusing to believe Jordan's excuses

people.name: Pepper
observations: Pepper sat on the counter watching Jordan chop garlic like a supervisor with no notes
